status: structurally-frozen-before-new-generation; exact prompt and item hashes still required
objective: Test whether target-disagreement knowledge externalized as rules, examples, or teaching can convert the exploratory 3B-to-8B seam into fresh-probe, articulation-specific substitution.

priority_cells.metric: Plain language, readability, and minimal jargon
Pitch/query and synopsis effectiveness and professionalism

independence.development: Existing probes may be used only to locate residuals and write teaching content.
independence.unit_certification: Fresh items disjoint from development and lockbox; used for CUF U1-U5 and controls.
independence.lockbox: At least 400 fresh source-held-out items per domain; no writer, selector, or optimizer sees target outcomes.
independence.target_execution: Target form orbit and stochastic passes are frozen before any smaller-reader lockbox execution.

provenance_arms.source_telling: Definition/rules derived from original construct sources; writer sees no target verdicts.
provenance_arms.residual_teaching: Teacher sees development disagreements and writes general recognition lessons without copying item text.
provenance_arms.ostensive_teaching: Development-only positive/negative contrasts plus boundary cases; no lockbox examples.
provenance_arms.formative_sequence: Ordered lesson, learner attempt, critique, and revised recognition rule, frozen as one transferable message.
provenance_arms.composed: Certified units/complexes jointly phrased with order/persona variants.
provenance_arms.fitted_optimizer: Outcome-optimized prompt search, reported separately and never pooled with telling/teaching.

controls: three-form length-matched inert filler at the selected dose
three-form wrong-construct content matched by channel and length
planted procedural application controls for each executor
unit_requirements: CUF U1 detectability with materiality floor
U2 form identity over canonical/question/boilerplate paraphrase orbit
U5 cross-scale E-SHARED versus E-DRIFT fingerprint decision

primary_read.fidelity: direct held-out Spearman with positive polarity
primary_read.selection: development-only minimal certified cost reaching the larger sparse baseline
primary_read.decision: baseline gap, improvement, non-inferiority, signature floor/improvement/non-inferiority, and matched-control specificity

claim_ladder: potential/triangle test only after all required hop debts are finite
